description: Stage 4c dedicated cases: the generic control-flow statement shell (ControlFlowStatementPossibleShape). Each case asserts: (1) shell-path XML == legacy-path XML byte for byte (the harness parses the same source again with StatementRouteUtil.EnableShellExpressions=false); (2) AST node-for-node == ts.createSourceFile; (3) two parses of the same source give identical XML; (4) no StatementShape shell leaks into the shape tree. Takeover counters (ControlFlowShellCount / BlockBodyStatementCount) and the no-file-fallback expectation are asserted by tests/statement-possible/control-flow-takeover.mjs; readings are recorded in HANDOFF-s4c.md.

stage4c.description: Generic control-flow shell: if / if-else / else-if / while / do-while / for / for-in / for-of / switch / switch-default / switch-break / try-catch / try-finally / try-catch-finally / with / return / throw / break / continue / debugger / empty statement, nesting, comments, ASI, and the same families inside a block body (block catalog). The two label cases (s4c-label, s4c-label-loop) guard label correctness on the expression-shell path; labels are deliberately NOT in the control-flow takeover set (see statement-route-util EnableControlFlowLabel); empty statements (`;`) are likewise kept on the legacy path (EnableControlFlowEmpty default false), the two empty cases guard correctness only.

cases.name: s4c-else-if
cases.source: if (a) b; else if (c) d; else e;

cases.name: s4c-switch-default
cases.source: switch (a) { case 1: b; break; default: c; }

cases.name: s4c-try-catch-finally
cases.source: try { a; } catch (e) { b; } finally { c; }
